title: Symrise celebrates third World Vanilla Day with global activities
summary: ‒ Symrise brings the taste, scent, origin and diversity of vanilla to life worldwide ‒ From Holzminden to Madagascar: Symrise highlights responsibility and partnership along the value chain ‒ As a vanilla pioneer and strategic partner, Symrise is helping shape the future of vanilla
